DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 送金内容の確認ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to check the transfer details?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 円で一万円のつもりでしたが、画面の通貨が違います。まだ送りませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 円予定額を別通貨欄へ入力した未実行を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I meant to send 10,000 yen, but the screen shows a different currency. I have not sent it yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you entered an intended yen amount in a different-currency field but have not executed it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの通貨と表示されていますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この表示です。数字の一万円だけ合えばよいとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通貨表示と数字を分けて示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: This one. I will not assume matching the number 10,000 is enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the currency separately from the number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 入力の意味と換算条件を担当が説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will explain what the entry means and the conversion conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 相手に届く額と、私が円で払う合計を分けて知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 相手受取額と円支払額を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to know separately the amount the recipient gets and the total I pay in yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the recipient’s amount and your payment in yen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 手数料や確認時点も合わせて案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will also explain fees and when the information was checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 昨日見た換算額をそのまま使わず、今の案内と見比べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 換算条件の時点を比較する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will compare it with the current information rather than use yesterday’s converted amount unchanged.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Compare when the conversion conditions apply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: まだ入力を確定せずお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please wait without confirming the entry yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。通貨と受取額、手数料、支払合計が分かってから進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通貨と費用の説明後に確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will proceed after understanding the currency, recipient amount, fees and total payment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm after the currency and costs are explained. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 未実行の入力として担当へおつなぎします。通貨と金額の意味を確認後に操作してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will connect you to the person in charge as an unexecuted entry. Check the meanings of the currency and amount before operating it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 会計のお手伝いですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you need help with checkout?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同じ物を二個ですが、画面には一個です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二商品一読の相違を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have two of the same item, but the screen shows one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Point out that two products are present but only one was scanned. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: You have not paid yet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。未読の一個を通してから払いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未払いで未読修正を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Correct. I want the unscanned item scanned before paying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have not paid and ask to correct the missed scan. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらで画面を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the screen here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 読み直す前に、二重に増えないかも見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 再読の重複防止を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Before rescanning, please also check that it will not add a duplicate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to prevent a duplicate when rescanning. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 合計は二個になりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: The total quantity is now two.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 確認しました。袋の二個と一致しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 画面と現物を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have checked. That matches the two in my bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Compare the screen with the actual products. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お支払いをお願いします。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 払います。最後のレシートの個数も見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 支払後の個数記録を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will. I will also check the quantity on the final receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the quantity record after payment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二個分の支払いを確認しました。商品二個とレシートをお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Payment for two is confirmed. Please take both products and the receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 道の手すりの下に工具が落ちています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 落下工具を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: There is a tool lying below the handrail along the path.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the dropped tool. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いえ、工事の物かも不明なので触っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未接触と所有不明を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. I do not even know whether it belongs to the construction work, so I have not touched it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have not touched it and its ownership is unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell me where it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 西の橋の手前です。通行の邪魔になりそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 位置と通行影響を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Just before the western bridge. It may obstruct people passing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the location and effect on passage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will contact the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分で手すりへ掛け直さず、近くを通る友人にも場所を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 無断移動せず同行者へ共有する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not hang it back on the handrail myself. I will also tell my friend passing nearby where it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not move it without permission; share its location with your companion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 別の道で休憩所へ行けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can take another path to the rest area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そちらが希望です。工具の所で待ち続けません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 別経路で休憩へ行く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I would prefer that. I will not stay waiting beside the tool.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Take an alternative route to rest. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 工具の場所を担当へ報告しました。こちらの道で休憩所へお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14218-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have reported the tool’s location. Please use this path to the rest area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗車位置についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about where to board?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 途中の駅から友人が乗ります。同じ車両に乗れるよう、位置を決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 途中駅の友人と同じ車両で合流したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend will board at a station along the way. I want to decide where so we can meet in the same carriage.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to meet a friend boarding midway in the same carriage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 号車番号は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know the carriage number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。前の方と伝えましたが、友人のホームでは前がどちらか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 方向だけの案内では不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I said toward the front, but I do not know which way is the front on my friend’s platform.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that direction alone is unclear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 号車番号を使えば確認しやすくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Using the carriage number makes it easier to check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では三号車の入口を目印にします。列車が変わる可能性があるので、乗る列車の時刻も送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 号車と列車時刻を目印にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then we will use the entrance of carriage three as the meeting point. The train might change, so I will also send the departure time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Use the carriage number and train time as references. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 停車中にホームへ降りて迎える予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you plan to get onto the platform to meet your friend during the stop?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: いいえ。降りると乗り遅れそうなので、車内で待ち、乗ったら連絡してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ホームに降りず車内で待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: No. I might miss the train if I get off, so I will wait inside and ask my friend to contact me after boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will stay inside instead of getting off onto the platform. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 友人が間に合わなかった場合も決めておくとよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: It is also good to decide what to do if your friend is too late.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その場合は無理に乗らず、次の列車で来てもらいます。私も勝手に降りず、先に連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 乗遅れ時の別移動と連絡を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then they will not rush aboard, but take the next train. I will contact them first instead of getting off without telling them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide on separate travel and communication if your friend misses the train. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 号車と発車時刻を表示で確認してからお伝えください。ホームでは走らずお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Check the carriage number and departure time on the display before telling your friend. Please wait without running on the platform.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 住民票の申請でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you applying for a residence-record certificate?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分が平日に来られないので、家族に受取を頼めるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人が来られず家族受取を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I cannot come on weekdays, so I would like to ask whether my family can collect it for me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about collection by family because you cannot come yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 申請も家族に頼む予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Will you ask them to apply for you too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今は受取だけを考えています。申請から全部代理でできると思っているわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 申請と受取の代理範囲を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: For now, I am only considering collection. I do not assume they can act for me throughout the whole application.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the representative’s role in applying from collecting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 代理の範囲と必要資料を担当へ確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the permitted scope and required documents with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。家族というだけで手ぶらで受け取れるとは考えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族にも必要資料の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I do not assume family can collect it without bringing anything just because they are family.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to confirm documents needed even for family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 提出先が求める内容は分かっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you know what information the recipient requires?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 世帯全員ではなく私の分です。必要な項目も提出先へ確認してから申請します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人分と提出先の必要項目を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is for me, not the whole household. I will check the required particulars with the recipient before applying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that it is for you alone and identify the recipient’s required particulars. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 準備一覧をお渡しできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can give you a preparation checklist.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。代理する範囲と書類を一覧で確認し、家族が再度来なくて済むよう準備します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一覧で範囲と資料を確認して家族へ渡す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will check the scope and documents against the list and prepare so my family does not have to come again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the scope and documents on the list and pass them to your family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらが相談窓口です。本人分の証明と代理受取の準備について担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: This is the consultation desk. Tell the person in charge about your own certificate and preparation for collection by a representative.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 診察券をお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please give me your patient card.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 先週、別の病院で検査を受けました。その結果を今日の先生にも見てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 他院検査結果を診察で見てほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I had tests at another hospital last week. I would like today’s doctor to see the results too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want the doctor to review another hospital’s test results. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 結果の用紙はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the results sheet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。日付と病院名が入っています。写真だけでなく、この原本を持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 日付病院名付き原本を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. It includes the date and hospital name. I brought the original, not just a photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Present the original with the date and hospital name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当へ持参したことを伝えます。紹介状もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will tell the person in charge that you brought it. Do you also have a referral letter?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 紹介状はありません。検査結果があるだけで、紹介状の代わりになるとは思っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 紹介状はないと明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: No referral letter. I do not think test results alone substitute for one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Make clear that you have no referral letter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今気になる症状は同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Are the symptoms concerning you now the same?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 痛む場所は同じですが、昨日から時間が長くなりました。前の結果だけで今も問題ないと判断したくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 症状の継続時間の変化を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: The pain is in the same place, but since yesterday it lasts longer. I do not want to decide that everything is still fine based only on earlier results.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the change in how long symptoms last. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 現在の変化も問診票へ書いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also write the current change on the medical questionnaire.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。結果の用紙と、昨日からの変化を分けて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 資料と現在症状を分けて伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will explain the results sheet separately from the change since yesterday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish the documents from current symptoms. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 資料を担当へ回します。診察では現在の症状も直接お伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass the documents to the person in charge. Please also explain your current symptoms directly during the consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何をなくされましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 黒い傘です。同じ色のものが多いので、柄の特徴も伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 黒い傘と特徴を伝えたいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: A black umbrella. Many have the same color, so I want to describe the handle too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Offer to describe the black umbrella and its identifying features. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 持ち手に青いひもがあり、先に小さい傷があります。写真はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 持手のひもと傷を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: There is a blue cord on the handle and a small scratch at the tip. I do not have a photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the handle cord and scratch. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 最後に使った場所は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you know where you last used it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 駅から図書館へ歩く時です。その後、どこへ置いたかは覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 最後の使用経路と置いた場所不明を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: While walking from the station to the library. I do not remember where I put it afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the route where you last used it and say you do not know where you left it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 図書館へは確認しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you checked with the library?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだです。ここへ届け出てから、図書館の受付にも置き忘れを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 図書館への確認が未実施で次に行うと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not yet. After reporting it here, I will also ask the library reception whether I left it there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you have not checked the library yet and will do so next. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご連絡先をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please give me your contact details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この番号です。似た傘が見つかっても、色だけで私のものと決めず、ひもと傷を照合してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡先を提示し複数特徴で照合を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: This number. Even if a similar umbrella is found, please compare the cord and scratch rather than identify it as mine from color alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give your contact details and ask to compare several features. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 特徴と連絡先を記録します。見つかった物の確認方法は担当からご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will record the features and contact details. The person in charge will explain how to identify a found item.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 海外へ送る書類でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are these documents for overseas shipping?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 書類の封筒ですが、小さいキーホルダーも入れています。書類だけの扱いでよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 書類と小物の同封を申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is an envelope of documents, but there is also a small key ring inside. Can it be treated as documents only?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Declare the documents and enclosed small item. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 中身によって手続きが変わるので、同封物を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The procedure depends on the contents, so we will check the enclosure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。薄いからといって、キーホルダーまで書類とは言えませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 薄さで書類扱いと判断しないと理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. Being thin does not make the key ring a document, does it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand that thinness does not determine document classification. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 送り先の国をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell me the destination country.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ベトナムです。相手へ贈る小物で、仕事の書類とは別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 国と贈答小物の用途を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Vietnam. The small item is a gift for the recipient, separate from the work documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the country and the small item’s purpose as a gift. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 利用できる方法と申告内容を担当へ確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check the available methods and declaration details with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。書類だけと書いた用紙は、正しい内容へ直してから出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 内容申告を修正してから発送する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I will correct the form saying documents only before sending.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Correct the contents declaration before dispatch. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 急ぐ期限はありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 来週までに届くと相手へ約束はしていません。方法と日数の案内を聞いてから発送を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未約束の期限と方法確認後の発送判断を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have not promised the recipient it will arrive by next week. I will decide whether to send it after hearing the methods and transit times.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you have not promised a deadline and will decide after checking methods. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 国と中身を担当へ伝えます。申告は同封物も含めて確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will tell the person in charge the country and contents. Check the declaration including the enclosed item.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 現金のご入金でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to deposit cash?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。でも、この一万円札は祖母にもらった物です。あとで一万円を下ろせば、この同じ紙幣が戻ってくるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 思い出の一枚が出金時に同じ現物として戻るか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. But my grandmother gave me this 10,000-yen note. If I withdraw 10,000 yen later, will I get this same banknote back?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the keepsake note itself will be returned when withdrawing money. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 口座の金額と、今お持ちの紙幣そのものは別です。同じ一枚をお返しするお約束はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Your account balance and the actual banknote you are holding are separate. We cannot promise to return that same note.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうなのですね。番号が同じ物を返してほしいのではなく、この一枚を思い出として残したいと気付きました。まだ預けていませんよね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現物を残したいと述べまだ預けていないか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I see. I realize I do not mean wanting a note with the same number back; I want to keep this particular note as a memory. I have not handed it over yet, have I?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you want to keep the actual note and check that you have not deposited it yet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まだ現金をお預かりしていません。入金する物を、ご自身で分けていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We have not received the cash yet. Could you separate what you want to deposit yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。この一枚は財布へ戻します。残りの五千円札二枚だけを入金したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 記念の一枚を戻し入金する二枚を分けて伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will put this note back in my wallet. I would like to deposit only the other two 5,000-yen notes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Put back the keepsake and identify the two notes for deposit separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、入金するのは合計一万円ですね。残す紙幣の金額と混ぜずに確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then your deposit totals 10,000 yen. Please check it without including the value of the note you are keeping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。今日の入金は一万円です。祖母の一万円札は手元に残すので、二万円の入金とは書きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 残す紙幣を含めず入金額一万円を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Today’s deposit is 10,000 yen. I am keeping my grandmother’s 10,000-yen note, so I will not write 20,000 yen as the deposit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm a 10,000-yen deposit without including the note you are keeping. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 入金する二枚と申込内容を確認します。記念の一枚は、お手元にしまいましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check the two notes for deposit and the application. Have you put the keepsake note away?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: しまいました。残した一枚は口座の残高には入りません。入金する二枚だけをお渡しし、控えでも一万円か確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現物をしまい入金用二枚だけを渡して控えの金額を確かめると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. The note I kept does not become part of my account balance. I will hand over only the two for deposit and check that the receipt also says 10,000 yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you have put the note away, will hand over only the two for deposit and check the receipt amount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの二枚をお預かりします。入金内容の確認後、控えの金額をお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will take these two notes. After confirming the deposit details, please check the amount on your receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ナッツの袋はお一つですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is that one bag of nuts?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一つですが、中に二種類入れました。札を見ると値段が違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 異なる価格の二種類を同袋にしたと申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: One bag, but I put two types inside. The tags show different prices.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Declare that you put two differently priced types in the same bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらで種類を確認しましょう。まだ重さのラベルは出していませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the types here. You have not printed a weight label yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、出していません。混ぜてよいと思い、自分で入れてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未ラベル発行と混ぜた経緯を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Correct. I thought mixing them was allowed and filled the bag myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that no label was printed and explain how you mixed them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この袋は担当に預けてください。ご自身で売場の容器へ戻さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please give this bag to the person in charge. Do not return its contents to the sales containers yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。元の容器へ戻さず、袋ごと渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 元容器へ戻さず袋を担当へ渡す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will hand over the whole bag rather than put them back in the original containers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Hand the bag to staff without returning its contents to the original containers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 購入したい種類と量は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you decided which types and quantities you want?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 両方少しずつ欲しいです。正しい袋分けと量り方を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二種少量の希望と計量方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like a little of both. Please show me the correct bagging and weighing methods.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for small amounts of two types and how to weigh them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が新しい袋を二つ用意します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will prepare two new bags.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。種類ごとに計量し、それぞれのラベルを確認して会計します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 別計量と各ラベル確認後に会計する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will weigh each type separately, check each label and then pay.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Pay after weighing separately and checking each label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 新しい袋はこちらです。最初の袋は担当で扱い、計量の手順をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15205-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here are the new bags. Staff will handle the first bag and explain the weighing steps.
